label: oracle-assisted navigation replay
instructions: Use explicitly configured local member roots and validate member-qualified expected paths before replay.
Verify authored SHA-256 fingerprints where supplied. Capture and recheck labeled-file fingerprints around each task; unrelated repository content is not frozen.
Issue the frozen initial query. Each search or more call counts toward the same three-page limit; every operation counts toward the eight-call limit.
Select relevant member/path hits in returned rank order using the authored labels. This selection is oracle-assisted, not an agent decision.
Require the emitted member-to-canonical-root mapping to match the configured owner before crediting metadata discovery.
Read immutable handles with show and follow only returned source continuations. Never replace them with current-path reads.

Credit source evidence only after complete successful delivery with matching member, root, path, revision, and emitted original bytes. Path-only labels credit byte evidence somewhere in that file; optional spans require full coverage.
When required, request ctx for a selected handle and require matching member, root, subject revision, and a complete nonempty relationship list.
Follow result continuations after relevant reads; reserve one result page for each remaining frozen followup query.
Stop at complete evidence and required context, exhaustion, three result pages, or eight calls. Preserve misses, unknown token counts, partial delivery, spent costs, and censoring.
Report path discovery and source evidence separately. Neither establishes semantic completeness, correct feature placement, or agent effectiveness.
